The CI log shows 102 tests pass and the package.json diff confirms no dependency changes — but neither attested artifact demonstrates that the *stale-quote eviction bug specifically* was fixed. There's no evidence of a new or failing-then-passing regression test targeting that bug, so AC#1 ("the bug is fixed") is not actually verified by the admissible (ATT) evidence. The only claim that the bug itself is fixed comes from the self-report (SELF), which is not sufficient on its own.
